verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk operation documented is Bulk Import, which maps and imports many exported items at once. The AI assistant can also plan multi-step work and propose creates and updates for approval. The REST API is only a developer building block and earns no credit, and no in-app bulk edit, tag, move or delete across many selected items is documented. Missing for 10: documented bulk editing, tagging or deleting of multiple existing items, evidence that the AI can apply changes across many items at once, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
